fields.Name: ORD-40 - Concessions
fields.Description: Concessions valued however they are delivered, and approved before the customer sees them (CS1-CS25). The sales guardrails used to value a concession only as a percentage off price, so a term extended at no charge computed to 0% and cleared every check. A booked term's dates are fixed, so an extension is recorded as a Duration concession, valued at the term's amount over its length and judged on both value and length. Outside a rep's SalesAuthority a concession waits for a holder of the ConcessionLimit rule's role; an order carrying one, or a stated price below the engine's that no approved concession covers, cannot be confirmed until it is decided, whether or not the line is flagged PriceOverridden. Removing a draft line removes its concessions. A bundle's components are priced at their share of the bundle price, which is not a concession. A manual discount inside its percentage cap still escalates on its absolute value. Every concession on an order that is not Rejected is also measured, together, as a share of the order's net total against the SalesAuthority's MaxConcessionPctOfContract; a draft that shrinks after a concession was approved on the rep's own authority holds the confirm until that concession is withdrawn and recorded again. A Pending concession is routed to its approvers through the tasks app: each gets its own approval task, titled with the order, the concession and its amount, linking the order and that concession, and assigned to the person records of the rule role's active holders other than the requester; a decision recorded on the task decides only that concession, as the user who recorded it; a decision the concession refuses puts it back in front of its approvers on a fresh task and records why; withdrawing it cancels its task and deciding it on its record completes or cancels its task. A confirmed order's payment terms change only through a Terms concession, which is valued in days to payment, always waits for someone other than the requester, and on approval moves the terms and the due date; the entity and trigger 51018 refuse a direct edit, and the due date stays correctable.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Moving a booked term's end date is refused with a pointer to Duration concessions; a 30-day extension of a 1200 term against a 30-day limit is Pending at 1200 x 30 / term days and holds the order's documents; a 14-day extension inside both limits is Approved on save and stamps the authority; a user without the rule's role cannot approve, a holder can, and a decision is not reopened; with no ConcessionLimit rule the concession is refused; a draft line typed at 60 against an engine price of 100 holds the confirm until a Price concession of 80 is approved; a Pending seats concession holds the confirm and withdrawing it releases the order; a 10% manual discount worth 100 escalates past a 50 value limit; a line priced at 60 through the API without PriceOverridden holds the confirm; removing a draft line deletes its Approved concession; a bundle of parts priced 75 and 25, sold at 80 and saved as a draft, writes its components at 60 and 20 and still confirms. Against a 5% share limit: on a 1200 annual order a Duration concession of ceil(5% of the term's days) is Pending and one a day shorter is Approved, with the order's net total and the share recorded; three free seats at 100 are Pending on a 500 order and Approved on a 10000 one; 95 against 100 on two units is Pending at 5.3% and one free unit beside 100 paid units is Approved at 1%; two 3% seat concessions on one order leave the second Pending at 6%; a 3% concession approved on authority holds the confirm once the order shrinks to 500, is withdrawn, and recorded again is Pending. Two Pending seats concessions on one order each raise their own Open ORDERS_CONCESSION_APPROVAL task, titled '<order>: 3 added seats, 300.00' and '<order>: 2 added seats, 200.00', each linking the order and its one concession and assigned to role holders' person records, and the order points at the newer; an Approved decision on the first task approves only the first concession, with the decider and the note, and the order still cannot confirm; an approval by a user without the role leaves the concession Pending, raises a fresh Open task under the same title that the order points at, and records the refusal on the first task; withdrawing a concession cancels its task and unlinks it, and approving the other on its record completes its task; a confirmed Net30 order refuses a direct move to Net60 through the entity and by direct SQL, while its due date is corrected without approval; a Terms concession recorded by a holder of the approving role within every limit is Pending at 30 days and 0 value, is not assigned to the requester, and the requester cannot approve it; approved by another user it moves the order to Net60 due 2026-08-30, and a direct SQL move back is refused; Orders.AmendArrangement previews 30 days and 2026-08-30 without writing, records a Pending concession, and refuses a second while it waits.
